messages:
elaine_acme: hey, we just discovered API keys baked into device logs shipped to S3. vendor says devices uploaded /var/logs/debug.log which contains our prod key. need immediate rotation and guidance.

mira_support: oh no, thanks for flagging. can you confirm the key id or the first 8 chars of the key? also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

elaine_acme: key starts with rwd_9f3b7a.. this is for our hosted account (org: acme-iot). devices are OTA-ing logs nightly.

alex_sec: pull the brakes: revoke that key ASAP. we should also create a replacement limited-scope key and push via OTA, then confirm old key is unusable.

mira_support: steps i recommend: 1) revoke the compromised key, 2) create a new key with narrowed scopes and short TTL, 3) push update to devices with the new key 4) search S3 + logs for other leaks 5) request audit log export for suspicious calls. i'll paste quick commands.

mira_support: revoke via API (replace <KEY_ID>):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/keys/<KEY_ID>/revoke" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

mira_support: create a scoped, short-live key (example):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/keys" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${REDACTED_ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"acme-iot-device-rotate","scopes":["inference.generate"],"expires_in":86400}'
```

elaine_acme: can we do key wrapping with our AWS KMS so the new key never appears in plaintext in Redwood? we are regulated and prefer customer-managed keys.

alex_sec: for hosted customers we support envelope encryption with your KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). create a data key in KMS, wrap the Redwood key with that key. if you need HSM-level guarantees for on-prem, we can offer Private deployment with HSM wrapping (requires enterprise support). i'll kick off the HSM lane if needed.

jordan_oncall: i'll start the audit. @sec-ops-bot can you export request logs for key rwd_9f3b7a* across the last 30 days and include source IPs and user-agents? we need timeline and device IDs.

sec-ops-bot: export job queued. ETA ~6m. export path: s3://redwood-exports/acme-iot/1829350000-logs-export.csv.gz. contains: timestamp, key_id, endpoint, ip, ua, device_id.

mira_support: while we wait - remediation checklist for your side (short):
- Revoke compromised key immediately (we can do on your behalf if you provide admin owner)
- Issue a replacement key with minimal scopes & short TTL
- Deploy new key via signed OTA update (use config server, do not log in plaintext)
- Rotate any CI/automation using the old key
- Run grep on S3 objects: `grep -R "rwd_9f3b7a"` or use S3 Inventory + Athena query to find objects containing the pattern

elaine_acme: do you recommend deleting S3 objects or redacting them? compliance wants evidence retention for 90 days but we can redact keys.

alex_sec: redact keys, keep metadata. create a redaction script that replaces patterns with <REDACTED_KEY> and store original file hash in a secure vault for audit. don't delete immediately — preserve chain of custody.

mira_support: note on audit logs retention: hosted default is 30 days. we can export and store longer in your S3 (as above). for Dedicated/Private customers, retention policies are configurable. open a ticket with account to extend retention if needed.

elaine_acme: if we rotate, how do we limit blast radius during rollout? we have 10k devices, OTA staged across regions.

jordan_oncall: do a canary push to 1% of devices and watch for auth errors. use rollout windows and a fast rollback plan. create a short-lived intermediate token that supports both old+new keys for a brief transition if OTA is flaky.

mira_support: final things we can do from platform side: 1) blacklist the compromised key so no new sessions are accepted 2) place rate limits on calls from suspicious IPs 3) surface token-level cost/latency traces to help detect anomalous usage.

elaine_acme: thanks. please revoke now and we will prepare OTA with the new key. we may ask for on-call support during rollout.

alex_sec: revoked rwd_9f3b7a (actioned). confirm with `curl -I https://api.redwood.inference/v1/keys/rwd_9f3b7a` should return 404/410 for revoked.

mira_support: sec-ops-bot export completed; i've shared the CSV in drive and DM'd the S3 link to the account owner. logging note: i've flagged this incident and created incident-3821 for compliance/audit followup.

elaine_acme: confirmed old key rejected. starting canary OTA. thanks all. will post update in this thread. :thumbsup:
